metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2026 · O.M: Operation Mole
metas.description: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2008 · Funny Games
metas.description: Two psychopathic young men take a family hostage in their cabin.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2005 · Land of the Dead
metas.description: The living dead have taken over the world, and the last humans live in a walled city to protect themselves as they come to grips with the situation.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.
